objectives: This course serves as a workshop focused on English presentation and communication skills. Whilst chosen texts will be used for the class, students are expected to develop their own materials for designated topics/focus. Audio and visual media will be applied intensively in the class. Students enrolled in the class are to prepare for presentation styles such as oral interpretation (consecutive and simultaneous), project reports, radio dramas, and live broadcasts for social media.
content: The class involves three major activities: lecture, one solo presentation & three group presentations. All students are required to complete assigned readings and writing before class, prepare for presentations, and comment on each other’s performances.
